a11y.instructions: Press space or enter to pick up a card, use the arrow keys to move it, then press space or enter again to drop it. Press escape to cancel.
a11y.cancelled: Move cancelled. The card returned to where it started.

0.name: Spy
0.text: If you're the only player who played a Spy this round, you gain an extra favor token when the round ends.

1.name: Guard
1.text: Name a rank other than Guard and pick an opponent. If they're holding that rank, they're out.

2.name: Priest
2.text: Privately look at another player's hand.

3.name: Baron
3.text: Privately compare hands with another player. Whoever holds the lower rank is out.

4.name: Handmaid
4.text: You can't be targeted by any card effect until your next turn.

5.name: Prince
5.text: Pick any player, including yourself. They discard their hand and draw a new card.

6.name: Chancellor
6.text: Draw two cards, then return two of your three cards to the bottom of the deck in an order you choose, keeping one.

8.name: Countess
8.text: You must discard this card if your other card is the King or the Prince.

9.name: Princess
9.text: If you discard this card for any reason, you're out.

loveLetter.countessForced: You must play the Countess while holding the King or the Prince.

chancellor.title: Choose a card to keep
chancellor.orderTitle: Click the cards in the order they should return to the bottom of the deck

event.chungoNoche: Pickpocketed — you lose all your items.
